node.name: footer · data statement
node.chars: Data: synthetic only — a seeded BTCUSDT (seed 574) 1m series of 800 bars to the forming bar 14:05 UTC; tick and qty step from the recorded instrument fixture; volumes, deltas, trades, prices, the thresholds' example bounds and the viewing-as user "Manager 01" are synthetic. No account data, key or balance. C-2.11 (R-1): the strip reads the live public trade stream on demo and live alike; no DEMO / LIVE badge and no environment control appears; nothing on this board differs by environment.

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: Theme: dark (exported as docs/design/E20/img/E20-D02-05-forming-partial-empty.png); §0 L60: 10 boards, 0 light twins — the light and high-contrast renders are not drawn, the text is binding; every fill here is a neutral token, so the T2 and breach grammar holds under any theme switch

kids.name: value-4
kids.chars: Greyscale, desktop, 1280 × 800 windows (§0): a wireframe — colour, type, iconography and elevation are E20-D03's

value-2.chars: The last bar's cells reuse SCR-030's forming-bar treatment (form E12-D06's; 14:759); the column header, the readout and the data cursor carry the word (W-7); each forming cell's accessible text ends ", forming"

value-3.chars: Values swap in place, no shimmer; no announcement (R-4)

value-4.chars: Delta % +57 % sits near the 60 % bound: a breach-state change (shade, glyph and word together) at most twice a second with a hold (FR-6, E47-D08:194), both motion modes; the readout shows the true value at once

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: SCR-030's partial-history boundary, variants and copy (14:762): left of it the cells are visually empty — no zero, no dash — each with the accessible text W-28, a stated absence (R-2)

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: The boundary tag reads W-8 and names the first available bar (13:56)

value-2.chars: No bar in range has recorded order flow: the label column stays, the cells are empty (W-28), one centred line reads W-9 (PROPOSED), a role="status" node announced once after a range change
